gaps.title: Complete real AST-to-SemanticIR lowering
gaps.disposition: Linux x64 LLVM18 uses AST-backed SemanticIR and verified source/SDK lowering.
gaps.remaining_exit: Broader platform lowering and nested ownership remain outside this execution scope.

gaps.title: Add representative end-to-end AI workloads
gaps.disposition: PR96 provides held-out classification and PR98 bounded family execution; broad claim-quality datasets and physical telemetry remain incomplete.
gaps.remaining_exit: Retain representative family datasets, quality-equivalent baselines and measured end-to-end trials.

gaps.title: Replace energy probing with a measurement-grade harness
gaps.disposition: PR95/97 implement collectors, raw-trace replay, uncertainty and pinned-baseline policy.
gaps.remaining_exit: Run calibrated controlled-hardware trials, retaining raw readings, failures, functional units and uncertainty.

gaps.title: Define a scientifically defensible “lowest power” benchmark claim protocol
gaps.disposition: Comparison contracts bind declared workloads, comparators, source, hardware, quality, timing and measurement policy; no universal superiority claim is allowed.
gaps.remaining_exit: Any future comparative claim needs separately reviewed, equivalent-quality physical evidence and bounded wording.

gaps.title: Close PR95 auditability and certification evidence bundle
gaps.disposition: PR91 signed bundles and PR101 pilot verification bind artifacts and replay assessments.
gaps.remaining_exit: Retain authentic field records, safety/privacy/accessibility review and independent claim approval.

gaps.title: Produce the final reproducible release candidate
gaps.disposition: PR99 executes SDK lifecycle and aggregates retained blockers; its implemented gate still reports no-go.
gaps.remaining_exit: Close the retained release blockers and qualify reproducible signed artifacts for the declared scope.

gaps.title: Protect `master` and production release controls
gaps.disposition: Protected publication policy exists; repository settings and actual protected-release execution require external verification.
gaps.remaining_exit: Verify master review/status/bypass controls, protected environment admission and real signed-tag attestations.

gaps.title: Eliminate production-truth drift
gaps.disposition: PR102 reads source/PR/head/tree/lineage and both required CI contexts from GitHub at release review time.
gaps.remaining_exit: Run live review on the merged release commit; unavailable or contradictory remote state cannot authorize publication.

gaps.title: Add real accelerator execution or explicitly constrain v1 scope
gaps.disposition: The declared AI production support set is linux-x64-cpu-v1; GPU/TPU/NPU production support is excluded.
gaps.remaining_exit: Separately live-qualify each accelerator before expanding scope or making cross-hardware claims.

gaps.title: Turn backend preferences into measured energy-aware selection
gaps.disposition: Measured configuration selection is bounded to qualified CPU candidates and declared constraints.
gaps.remaining_exit: Broader backend/model selection needs live evidence; inventory preferences cannot establish execution efficiency.

gaps.title: Complete executable/evidentiary AI lifecycle controls from C3-ECO Section 17
gaps.disposition: Typed AI lifecycle and declared-boundary accounting exist; representative execution does not yet cover all material lifecycle phases.
gaps.remaining_exit: Retain workload-specific training/inference/evaluation/monitoring/failed-run and quality-energy evidence where material.

gaps.title: Close C3-ECO Domain E, data lifecycle efficiency
gaps.disposition: PR100 validates declared data ingestion/storage/egress records and allocation boundaries.
gaps.remaining_exit: Produce material data-movement, retention, compression/index and repeated-movement observations per functional unit.

gaps.title: Complete attributable carbon-boundary evidence
gaps.disposition: PR89/100 calculate attributed compute, data, network and hardware lifecycle records without double counting.
gaps.remaining_exit: Substantiate material client, third-party, embodied and lifecycle phases with actual provenance and measurements.

gaps.title: Implement auditable carbon factors and cloud/shared allocation
gaps.disposition: Dated factors, attribution, shared allocation and hardware lifetime are validated for explicitly declared candidate boundaries.
gaps.remaining_exit: Independent factor authenticity and provider observations remain external; hosting claims cannot replace measured efficiency.

gaps.title: Add hardware longevity and low-resource evidence
gaps.disposition: Portability, SDK lifecycle and hardware-lifetime attribution exist; older-hardware and low-resource field baselines remain incomplete.
gaps.remaining_exit: Qualify minimum/older hardware, pressure limits and update/model payload regressions on retained workloads.

gaps.title: Close or scope composite dependency/runtime limitations
gaps.disposition: V1 uses curated offline packages, deterministic locks and bounded composite execution; nested ownership/FFI limits are explicit.
gaps.remaining_exit: Implement and qualify additional ownership/dependency semantics before expanding the declared language scope.

gaps.title: Strengthen enterprise diagnostics and developer observability
gaps.disposition: Source diagnostics, LSP and bounded lowering provenance are supported; full debugger/live reload and general profiling are excluded.
gaps.remaining_exit: Broader debugging and energy hot-path attribution require separately qualified tools and workload evidence.

gaps.title: Add an energy eco-regression release gate
gaps.disposition: PR97 enforces trace replay, quality-preserving comparison and conservative regression policy.
gaps.remaining_exit: Retain controlled physical baselines across releases and review measured regressions with uncertainty.

gaps.title: Implement measurement-quality, data-quality, and uncertainty gates as executable release logic
gaps.disposition: Native assessment checks MQ/DQ, materiality, evidence caps, uncertainty and conservative candidate recommendations.
gaps.remaining_exit: Certification levels still require an independent scheme decision; estimates cannot grant a level.

gaps.title: Make “no quality degradation” inseparable from energy optimization
gaps.disposition: Bounded application tests enforce accuracy/SLA/output constraints; full workload quality and organizational safeguards remain required.
gaps.remaining_exit: Validate relevant accuracy, reliability, latency, safety, privacy, security and accessibility alongside every energy comparison.

gaps.title: Decide the production package-registry strategy
gaps.disposition: The v1 registry is deliberately curated and offline with cryptographic locks; no public network registry is claimed.
gaps.remaining_exit: Any later network registry needs its own namespace, signing, revocation, transport and supply-chain threat model.

gaps.title: Keep all public capability documents machine-consistent
gaps.disposition: PR102 renders one capability block from machine-readable truth and checks README, backend matrix and public readiness text.
gaps.remaining_exit: Keep public fields synchronized and review prose outside generated capability blocks before publication.

gaps.title: Harden certification and environmental claim wording
gaps.disposition: Public wording identifies draft-standard candidate evidence and disallows certification, level, universal-lowest-carbon and production claims.
gaps.remaining_exit: A recognized scheme and independent evidence review are prerequisites to any later certification claim.

gaps.title: Add independent reproducibility before Platinum/Diamond-style or best-in-class claims
gaps.disposition: PR101 verifies separately signed repeats and organizational records but explicitly does not authenticate physical/legal independence.
gaps.remaining_exit: Obtain independent field reruns, calibrated measurements, uncertainty and a reviewer/lab decision bound to exact workload artifacts.

gaps.title: Operationalize surveillance and recertification if C3-ECO certification becomes a product goal
gaps.disposition: PR91/101 implement retention, expiry, surveillance, nonconformity and signed pilot-record verification.
gaps.remaining_exit: Actually operate retention/access/restore/surveillance controls and independently review material changes, suspension and claim correction.
